mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.perms, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.order_num, m.visible, m.status, m.create_time FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = 1 AND m.visible = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, perms, path, component, icon, order_num, visible, status, create_time FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
